# DevSecNinja — Org-Wide Copilot Instructions

These defaults apply to **every** DevSecNinja repository. They are distributed
from [`DevSecNinja/.github`](https://github.com/DevSecNinja/.github) by the
config-sync workflow — do not edit this file in a downstream repo (changes are
overwritten on the next sync). A repository's own
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` supplements or overrides these defaults.

## Pull requests

- **PR titles MUST follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)** —
  `type(scope): description`. PRs are **squash-merged**, so the PR title becomes
  the commit on `main` and feeds release-please's changelog and version bump.
  Get the title right even if the individual commits in the PR are informal.
  - Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `ci`, `chore`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`.
  - Use `feat!:` / `fix!:` (or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer) for breaking changes.
    For a centralized component (e.g. a new required input to a reusable
    workflow), this MUST be a breaking change so Renovate does not automerge a
    change that breaks downstream CI.
- **Run lint and tests before opening a PR**, and fix anything that fails:
  `mise exec -- lefthook run pre-commit` (and the repo's test command, if any).
  Do not open a PR with known-failing checks.
- **Update documentation in the same PR as the code it describes** — READMEs,
  inline docs, and any generated indexes. Don't leave docs to a follow-up.
- **Keep PRs focused** — one logical change per PR; avoid bundling unrelated work.
- **Never force-push to `main`** (or any shared/protected branch). All changes
  land via PR through normal CI; branch protection is always respected.

## Coding standards

- **Commit messages**: Conventional Commits, same types as above. Individual
  commits within a PR may be informal, but the PR title is authoritative.
- **YAML**: 2-space indent, start with `---`, format with yamlfmt, lint with yamllint.
- **Markdown**: format with dprint, 4-space indent.
- **Shell scripts**: Bash dialect, 4-space indent, lint with shellcheck, format with shfmt.
- **GitHub Actions**: pin all action refs to full commit SHAs with a version
  comment, e.g. `uses: actions/checkout@<sha> # v4.2.0`. Add a `# renovate:`
  comment where applicable so Renovate can bump it.
- **Reusable workflows** in `DevSecNinja/.github` MUST NOT default package / tool
  version inputs — declare them `required: true` so the calling repo owns the
  version (see
  [ADR 0001](https://github.com/DevSecNinja/.github/blob/main/docs/design-decisions/0001-reusable-workflow-version-inputs.md)).
- **Security**: never commit plaintext secrets. Use SOPS, Vault, or GitHub Secrets.

## Tool chain

All linting/formatting tools are managed by [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/)
(`.mise.toml`). Run tools via `mise exec -- <tool>`. Run
`mise exec -- lefthook run pre-commit` before committing.

## File conventions

- LF line endings; always end files with a trailing newline.
- Indent: 2 spaces (YAML/JSON), 4 spaces (Markdown/shell).
- Don't hand-edit generated files (e.g. `CHANGELOG.md`, release-please manifests,
  lockfiles) — regenerate them via their owning tool.
